title: Australia: card surcharge reset
description: eftpos, Mastercard and Visa no-surcharge rules apply from 1 October after the RBA removed its prohibition on those rules.

title: Domestic interchange: lower caps
description: Revised interchange regulation applies to domestic-issued card transactions acquired in Australia.

title: Issuer compensation rules change
description: The amended net-compensation regime starts, with transitional arrangements for 2026/27.

title: Scheme fees come into view
description: First quarterly aggregate fee publications by designated card networks were due for the July–September period.

title: Acquirer fee disclosures begin
description: Qualifying large acquirers must publish merchant service fee data by merchant size and card type.

title: Next: prove interchange pass-through
description: First publication of large acquirers’ interchange pass-through measures covers October–December 2026.

title: Foreign-issued cards get a cap
description: Interchange caps extend to foreign-issued card transactions acquired in Australia.

title: Merchant statements get sharper
description: More statement detail is required from the first full statement period starting on or after 1 April.

title: Scheme-fee roadmap expected
description: The RBA expects a scheme-fee roadmap by 1 April; this is an expectation, not a new fee cap.

title: NZ moves on commercial cards
description: The 22 October decision introduces commercial credit-card interchange limits on Mastercard and Visa.

title: Same Day ACH: $10 million limit
description: Nacha lists an increase of the Same Day ACH dollar limit to $10 million for 17 September 2027.

title: ACH credits: 9am availability
description: Non-Same Day ACH credits must be available by 9am in the receiving bank’s local time on settlement date.

title: ACH: IAT definition changes
description: Nacha lists its revised definition of International ACH Transactions among the September changes.

title: ACH availability exceptions update
description: Nacha lists changes to funds-availability exceptions for Non-Same Day credit entries. Check the rule text before changing controls.

title: IAT: optional date-of-birth field
description: Nacha lists the optional date-of-birth field for IAT entries for 19 March 2027.

title: ACH: register IAT contacts
description: Registration of IAT contacts in the ACH Contact Registry is listed for 1 January 2027.

title: UK scheme pricing: evidence required
description: Relevant scheme-fee decisions must comply with the PSR’s pricing-governance direction from the end of November.

title: UK fee transparency: next stage
description: Substantive information, transparency and complexity requirements apply from the end of July 2027, subject to the limited fee-logic extension.

title: Small fee lines: a limited extension
description: ITC Standard B is deferred for qualifying fee lines generating £850,000 or less in annual UK gross revenue. During the extension, acquirers can request that information without charge.

title: Safeguarding: the operating baseline
description: Daily reconciliations, monthly reports and resolution packs form part of the strengthened safeguarding regime. Audit requirements have exceptions.

title: EU PSR: Council first-reading position
description: The Council voting record documents adoption of its first-reading position on 29 October. This is a legislative milestone, not an application date. PSD3 and PSR must be tracked separately; no implementation date is asserted here.

title: Canada: RTR launch set for 9 November
description: Payments Canada confirms a scheduled 9 November launch. This preview does not describe the service as already live.

title: PSD3: Council first-reading position
description: The Council voting record documents its first-reading position on the payment and electronic-money services directive on 29 October. This is not an implementation deadline.
